title: 現況掃描｜AI 識圖丈量與 CAD 轉 BIM｜惠強 HQ Design
desc: 現場和舊圖不一樣，誰來量？惠強以 AI 識圖丈量與 CAD→BIM 建立現況模型，作為後續六段共用的基準；2026 年 4 月起導入。了解你需要準備什麼。
h1: 進場前，我們先量清楚什麼？
lede: 現況量清楚一次，後續六段都以同一份基準運算；舊圖與現場的落差在進場前被看見。
gloss: Site Survey — AI-assisted measurement from existing drawings and site data; CAD converted to a BIM base model.
inp: 既有建築／裝修圖（CAD 或紙本）、現場進入時段與大樓管制條件、營運中區域的範圍。
out: 現況 BIM 模型與現況平面；後續參數化方案、BIM 協調與施工圖說共用的基準檔。
q: 現場和舊圖不一樣，重新丈量要多久、要我準備什麼？
quote: 惠強室內裝修（HQ Design）在現況掃描階段，以 AI 識圖丈量讀取既有 CAD 或紙本圖面與現場量測資料，並將 CAD 圖轉為 BIM 現況模型，作為七段流程中後續六段共用的運算基準。AI 識圖丈量與 CAD→BIM 兩項自 2026 年 4 月起導入。
quote2: 業主端只需提供既有圖面與現場進入條件；辨識牆、柱、開口、設備位置與建立模型由惠強完成。
qen: Owners provide existing drawings and site access; HQ Design reads them with AI-assisted measurement and builds the BIM base that every later stage shares.
how_h2: 惠強室內裝修在現況掃描階段做哪三件事？
how: 讀取既有 CAD／紙本圖與現場量測資料，辨識牆、柱、開口與設備位置，減少人工逐點抄繪。
2026 年 4 月導入項目之一（公司簡介 Milestones），與 CAD→BIM、參數化多方案、BIM 報價整合並列四項。
將二維現況圖轉為帶尺寸與屬性的 BIM 模型：牆體、樓板、開口與機電幹管位置一次建立。
同一模型延用至 05 BIM 協調與 06 施工圖說——七段中有 3 段直接共用此基準。
記錄大樓管制、進料動線、營運時段與保全要求，作為後續分區施工計畫的前提。
2025 年 SECOM 南港總部 5,940 sqm 於營運中總部施工，進場前即建立施工區隔、非核心時段進料與安全動線條件。
cap: 點雲網格經 AI 識圖丈量與 CAD→BIM，轉為帶尺寸線的現況平面；品牌色標示的柱位為模型中被保留的既有結構。
why_h2: 現況掃描對業主的意義是什麼？
why: 後續每一段都以同一份現況為準
平面、立面、剖面與報價數據來自同一套模型，不再各自維護。
舊圖與現場的落差在進場前被看見
問題不在拆除後才發現，返工與工期風險不由業主承擔。
你只需提供既有圖與進場條件
辨識、建模與現地條件建檔由惠強完成。
ev_none: 目前尚無可公開引用的階段證據。AI 識圖丈量與 CAD→BIM 自 2026 年 4 月起導入；2024 年前完成之案件不列為本階段的 AI 流程證據，以免誤導。首批以此流程完成並驗收的案件將補列於此。
titleEn: Site Survey — AI-assisted measurement and CAD to BIM
descEn: Site and old drawings never match — who measures? HQ Design builds a BIM base model with AI-assisted measurement and CAD conversion, in place since April 2026.
h1En: What do we measure before work starts?
ledeEn: Measure the existing condition once and the six later stages all compute from the same baseline; the gap between old drawings and the actual site surfaces before anyone enters.
inpEn: Existing architectural and fit-out drawings (CAD or paper), site access windows and building control conditions, and the extent of areas that stay in operation.
outEn: An existing-condition BIM model and plans — the baseline file shared by parametric options, BIM coordination and construction documentation.
howH2En: What does HQ Design do during the site survey?
whyH2En: What does the site survey mean for the owner?
howEn: Existing CAD or paper drawings and site measurements are read to identify walls, columns, openings and equipment positions, reducing point-by-point manual tracing.
The two-dimensional existing-condition drawings become a BIM model carrying dimensions and attributes: walls, slabs, openings and main MEP runs established in one pass.
Building controls, delivery routes, operating hours and security requirements are recorded as the premise for the later phased construction plan.
whyEn: Every later stage works from the same baseline
Plans, elevations, sections and cost data come from one model instead of being maintained separately.
The gap between old drawings and the site surfaces before work starts
Problems are not discovered after demolition, so rework and programme risk do not fall to the owner.
You only provide existing drawings and access conditions
Recognition, modelling and the record of site conditions are handled by HQ Design.
evNoneEn: No citable evidence for this stage yet. AI-assisted measurement and CAD to BIM have been in place since April 2026; projects completed before 2024 are not listed as evidence of this AI process, to avoid misleading. The first projects delivered and accepted through it will be added here.
figAltEn: Site survey diagram: a site point-cloud grid on the left is converted, through AI-assisted measurement and CAD to BIM, into a dimensioned existing-condition plan and model baseline on the right.
